ValidationRule.description: Prevents unauthorized changes to cc_Checker_Result__c for Investment Questionnaire Review records based on the configured user and record conditions.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( RecordType_DeveloperName__c = "Investment_Questionnaire_Review", $User.Maker_Checker_Bypass_Flag__c = false, ISCHANGED(cc_Checker_Result__c), NOT(ISPICKVAL(cc_Checker_Result__c, "")), Address_Updated_By__c = $User.Id, $User.LastName <> "Integration" )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You cannot change the Checker Result for an Investment Questionnaire Review record.
